canada.title: Alberta legislation planned on ‘merit’ in public-sector hiring, data centres, report cards
canada.summary: The United Conservative Party laid out its plans for legislation tied to data centres, event tickets, report cards and more as part of the upcoming fall sitting. But what Albertans shouldn’t expect to see, the government said, are new laws tied to how they voted in the referendum on Monday.

canada.title: Yukon government asks court to toss Tr’ondëk Hwëch’in lawsuit over mining regulation changes
canada.summary: The territory has filed a statement of defence to the First Nation's lawsuit, arguing it wasn't obligated to consult before making changes to three mining-related regulations in 2025.

canada.title: Missing 85-year-old man found after Silver Alert issued: Winnipeg police
canada.summary: A missing 85-year-old man who was last seen in Winnipeg's St. Vital area on Wednesday night has been found.

canada.title: In North Kildonan, fresh ideas challenge decades of experience
canada.summary: Jeff Browaty hopes to mark his 20th year in politics with another election win in North Kildonan as two challengers attempt to dethrone him.

canada.title: Lack of security at psychiatric ER puts workers at risk in Quebec City hospital, unions say
canada.summary: Psychiatric emergency department workers say hospital security measures are lacking. They stood outside the Centre hospitalier de l'Université Laval (CHUL) in Quebec City Friday to demand safety improvements.

canada.title: 'We must take action': Georgina's Law debated in House of Commons 2nd reading
canada.summary: Georgina's Law — a bill spearheaded by an N.L. survivor of intimate partner violence — was a focus in Ottawa this week, during its second reading in the House of Commons.

canada.title: Police investigating double murder in Quebec’s Bas-St-Laurent region
canada.summary: Quebec provincial police are investigating after two women were shot and killed in the parking lot of a restaurant in Rivière-du-Loup, in Quebec's Bas-St-Laurent region.

canada.title: N.W.T. MLAs decry lengthy medical travel flights for seniors
canada.summary: MLAs in the Legislative Assembly are decrying lengthy flights for medical travel for seniors. Some are calling for change. The territory’s new health minister says he’s willing to look at anything — but did not promise any immediate, new exemptions.

canada.title: Developer pitching subdivision outside Shubenacadie gets earful
canada.summary: An open house about a proposed subdivision that could bring dozens of homes near the Shubenacadie Wildlife Park started with the proponent informing area residents that construction could theoretically start at any time.

canada.title: Wolf attack in northern Saskatchewan injures contractor
canada.summary: A person suffered non-life-threatening injuries after being attacked by a wolf in northern Saskatchewan earlier this week, the province's community safety ministry has confirmed.

canada.title: U.S. price-fixing case advances against Canadian frozen potato giants
canada.summary: New Brunswick’s McCain Foods Limited and J.D. Irving-owned Cavendish Farms were among five defendants seeking the case’s dismissal.

canada.title: Inquest into death of Regis Korchinski-Paquet set to continue
canada.summary: A coroner’s inquest into the death of a Toronto woman who fell from a highrise balcony in the presence of police is set to resume this afternoon after adjourning early on Thursday.

canada.title: 25 years after project first began, final stretch of Team Gushue Highway is opening Friday
canada.summary: Twenty-five years after construction started, the Newfoundland and Labrador government says the final phase of the Team Gushue Highway is opening Friday.

canada.title: Warnings out for widespread wind, potential precipitation in Sask.
canada.summary: Halloween decorations may be taking flight in Saskatchewan, with wind gusts projected to reach up to 100 km/h in some areas.

canada.title: Sentencing delayed a week for man who murdered, dismembered wife
canada.summary: A man who was set to be sentenced next week for murdering and dismembering his wife will instead be sentenced in early November.

canada.title: Advocates point to contributions, not costs, of newcomers in Alberta referendum aftermath
canada.summary: A union representative for a beef processing plant south of Calgary is warning of worsening labour shortages if immigration policy proposals that narrowly passed in Alberta's referendum are enacted.

canada.title: Boon or boondoggle? N.S. weighs $10B data centre’s promised economic benefits
canada.summary: Living more than 200 kilometres from the site of a major artificial intelligence data centre proposal isn't stopping Michael McCluskey from voicing his opposition to the project.

canada.title: More Hamilton voters cast advance ballots this municipal election than in 2022
canada.summary: Hamilton has surpassed the total number of advance ballots cast during the 2022 municipal election, with less than a week remaining before election day.
